parameters.content:
## LEARNING - Generate Quiz (RFC-022)

**Description:** Génère un quiz pédagogique avec questions et réponses via LLM

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/learning-generate-quiz

**InputSchema:**
```json
{"type":"object","required":["topic"],"properties":{"topic":{"type":"string","description":"Sujet du quiz (ex: techniques de pâtisserie)"},"num_questions":{"type":"integer","default":10,"description":"Nombre de questions"},"difficulty":{"type":"string","enum":["easy","medium","hard"],"description":"Niveau de difficulté"}}}
```

**Injected by plugin:** prompt, lesson_id, guild_id, content, model, max_tokens

**Returns:** Quiz with generated questions saved to API
